checks.title: Entry-timing difference is declared
checks.detail: kernel enters at the hourly close; the live bot scans every 5 min on a forming candle, so the kernel reads pumps +0.54pp larger on average (188 matched setups). DECLARED LIMITATION: arena absolute WR is not live WR. Arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel — but a promoted arm must still survive the earlier live entry, and that caveat is attached to every surfaced verdict.

findings.claim: STATISTICAL REALITY: 'measured ghost arrival = 25.6 control trades/day', used to justify the confirm plan of n=600.
findings.problem: Nothing on the live tape supports 25.6/day. The live tier holds 25 events total across the whole 61.0-day span, and control's live accounting is live_n=4 + declined=17 + 4 still open = 25 events lifetime. The 25.6/day figure instead matches control's backfill screen_n=1541 over 61.0 days. It is a backfill arrival rate wearing the word 'measured', and at the actual live rate the planned confirm n=600 is not reachable in any stated horizon.

findings.claim: Checklist paired_population green: '4789 events in the shared window; every arm has seen all of them', with entry-8pct and vol-4x both reporting screen_dWR=0.0pp.
findings.problem: Seeing an event and being scored on it are different things. entry-8pct is scored on screen_n=494 and vol-4x on screen_n=861 against control's 1541 — these arms are scored on filtered subsets, not the identical population. Yet both report screen_dWR=0.0pp while their own screen_wr (51.417 and 51.103) differs from control's 49.903. A 0.0pp delta here is a not-computed placeholder rendered in the same column as placebo's genuine measured 0.0pp, so an unpaired arm reads as a confirmed null.

findings.claim: Checklist backfill_cannot_promote green: 'Only live-tape evidence can promote — 0 surfaced arm(s); none promoted from a screen'.
findings.problem: The gate reports green because it has never been exercised, not because it has held. Zero arms have surfaced, so no promotion decision has ever been put to it. Meanwhile every ranking number in the arena (screen_n up to 1541, screen_wr, screen_ev, screen_dWR) is backfill-derived — 4764 backfill events versus 25 live — and each arm carries live_n between 1 and 4. A green untested gate is not evidence that verdicts are resting on live tape.

findings.claim: Checklist entry_granularity_declared: the kernel reads pumps +0.54pp larger than the live bot, but 'arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel'.
findings.problem: Shared bias cancels only for arms that do not act on the biased quantity. entry-8pct changes pump_pct to 8.0 — its entire population is selected by the same pump measurement that is systematically +0.54pp high over 188 matched setups. The bias shifts which events clear the 8% gate, so entry-8pct's screen_n=494 is not the population the live bot would produce, while control's 1541 is far less sensitive to it. The blanket validity claim does not cover threshold arms.

findings.claim: Checklist graveyard_enforced green: '46 refutations loaded; probe naming peak-close was refused by G-01'.
findings.problem: The probe used a literal string already listed in G-01's blocks, so it tests exact-token matching against a token known to be present — it cannot establish that restatements are caught. The data shows the matcher's actual miss rate: of four dedup proposals, L-dedup-48h and L-dedup-0h were auto-refused as REFUTED_BEFORE via 'cascade', while L-dedup-24h and L-dedup-2h passed the matcher and had to be killed by narrative 'history:' reasoning. Automatic refusal caught half of a near-identical family.

findings.claim: The arena headline ranks arms by screen_dWR, with sl-5pct leading at +5.26pp and hold-12h at +3.18pp.
findings.problem: The stated objective is win-rate AND EV per trade net of costs, but the leading arm fails the second half on the same row: sl-5pct screen_ev=0.022 against control's screen_ev=0.029 on n=1540 vs n=1541. Its win-rate gain comes with EV below control — the exact 'a WR dial only' pattern the graveyard already recorded in G-08 and G-17 for peak-anchored stops. Presenting dWR as the ranking column, with no dEV column at all, surfaces an arm that is losing on the objective as the front-runner.
